titulo: Por (not para) for on behalf of / instead of
subtitulo: Trabajó por mí. Hazlo por mí.
regla: Use por (not para) for on behalf of, instead of, in someone's place: Mi compañero trabajó por mí. Para mí would mean the work was for my benefit.

bloques.texto: To say someone does something **instead of** you, **on your behalf**, **in your place**, use **por**.
**Para** + person means the **recipient** or the one who benefits: **compré un regalo para ti**.
**Por** + person can also mean _for the sake of_: **lo hago por ti** (_I do it for you, because of you_).
Tip: **por mí** = in my shoes; **para mí** = into my hands.

lista.es: Mi compañero tuvo que trabajar ==por mí== ayer.
lista.en: My coworker had to work for me yesterday. (in my place)

lista.es: ¿Podrías comprar el regalo de mi mamá ==por mí==? Estoy enferma.
lista.en: Could you buy my mom's present for me? I'm sick.

lista.es: El actor principal se sentía mal, así que un suplente actuó ==por él==.
lista.en: The lead actor felt sick, so an understudy performed in his place.

lista.es: Firmé ==por== mi hermano porque él no podía venir.
lista.en: I signed on my brother's behalf because he couldn't come.

lista.es: Todo lo que hago, lo hago ==por== mis hijos.
lista.en: Everything I do, I do for my kids. (for their sake)

lista.nota: **Por mí** = he covered for me. **Para mí** = I was his boss.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Can you go to the meeting for me?_ (in my place)
lista.r: ¿Puedes ir a la junta por mí?

lista.p: In Spanish: _She spoke on behalf of the group._
